reviews.title: Great AM4 board
reviews.comment: Great Mobo for the money.  Wish my postal service took better care though.  Board arrived warped however no errors or malfunctions.  Running great
reviews.author: Sarah G.

reviews.title: Very easy to install
reviews.comment: I've been working on computers since 1998, and this board was very easy to install in my Musetex case.
reviews.author: Relic

reviews.title: Looks good, cheap, stable.
reviews.comment: Runs no issue, boots in seconds with nvme and 5800x, pc games great with 2x16GB ram and 6900Xt.  Affordable with optional m2 for wireless card like a laptop would run, has holes for the antenna too!  I have used Asrock for Ryzen cpus many times and never had an issue with their boards.  Happy with this board and the price.

reviews.title: Missing key component
reviews.comment: Shipped without a backplate for the cooling fan. Really makes it hard to use a motherboard when you can't cool the CPU...
reviews.author: Staci McTeigue
